# eventurus.cn

> China travel tools and guides for international visitors: visas, transport,
> payments, connectivity, food and accommodation. Every guide states the month
> its facts were last verified.

## Visas and entry

- [China Visa Checker](https://eventurus.cn/visa-checker.html): Visa requirements by nationality, purpose and length of stay. Policies verified through July 2026.
- [China Visa-Free Entry Guide](https://eventurus.cn/visa-free-guide.html): Unilateral 30-day entry, 240-hour transit, Hainan and Guangdong schemes in one table.
- [China Entry Requirements](https://eventurus.cn/entry-requirements.html): Entry rules by nationality, updated through July 2026.
- [Accommodation Registration in China](https://eventurus.cn/accommodation-registration.html): The 24-hour rule for non-hotel stays, the national online system, Shanghai self-service, who may file and the exemptions. Checked against National Immigration Administration Announcement No. 7 of 2026.
- [Chinese Hospital Guide](https://eventurus.cn/hospital-guide.html): Registration, payment and pharmacy at a Chinese hospital as a foreign patient.
- [Emergency Guide](https://eventurus.cn/emergency-guide.html): Emergency numbers, lost-passport procedure and embassy contacts.

## Accommodation

- [Where to Stay near Shanghai](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay.html): Shanghai, Suzhou, Hangzhou, Wuzhen, Moganshan and Anji compared by trip length, nightly cost and travel time from Hongqiao. Hub for the Yangtze Delta cluster.
- [Where to Stay in Shanghai](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-shanghai.html): Neighbourhoods compared for first visits, nightlife, families and long stays, with rates and metro access.
- [Where to Stay in Beijing](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-beijing.html): Five areas compared for first visits, hutong stays, business and families, with airport transfer and booking traps.
- [Where to Stay in Hangzhou](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-hangzhou.html): Six areas around West Lake, with nightly rates, Metro Line 19 from Xiaoshan airport and which station to use.
- [Where to Stay in Suzhou](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-suzhou.html): Pingjiang Road, Guanqian, the west canals, Jinji Lake and Tongli, with station choice and rail fares from Shanghai.
- [Where to Stay in Wuzhen](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-wuzhen.html): Inside the gates or outside, four bases with ticket and re-entry rules and the transfer from Tongxiang station.
- [Where to Stay in Moganshan](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-moganshan.html): Yucun, the mountaintop villas, Laoling, Fatou and Deqing town, with transfer rules, tickets and rail times.
- [Where to Stay in Anji](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-anji.html): Dipu, Lingfeng, Tianhuangping, Shanchuan and Baofu, with rail times, where a car is needed and resort rates.
- [Where to Stay in Chengdu](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-chengdu.html): Five areas compared for first visits, courtyard stays and the panda reserve, with the Tianfu-versus-Shuangliu airport difference priced. Line 18 fares and the 24-hour airport bus.
- [Where to Stay in Chongqing](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-chongqing.html): Five areas across the peninsula and both banks, including which metro line crosses which river, Line 10 and Line 3 from Jiangbei airport, and the hillside-lift reality of a city built in layers.
- [Where to Stay in Xi'an](https://eventurus.cn/where-to-stay-xian.html): Inside the Ming walls or outside them, five areas with Metro Line 2 access, Line 14 from Xianyang airport, and the difference between the Bell Tower and the South Gate.
- [Hotel Booking for Foreigners](https://eventurus.cn/tools/accommodation-guide.html): Which Chinese hotels accept foreign guests and what to check before paying.

## Transport

- [China City Transit Matrix](https://eventurus.cn/transit-matrix.html): High-speed rail against flying between major cities, priced door to door rather than airport to airport.
- [Airport to City Transport](https://eventurus.cn/airport-transport.html): Taxi, metro and shuttle prices from 27 Chinese airports, with night-arrival and luggage notes.
- [Train Ticket Booking Guide](https://eventurus.cn/train-booking-guide.html): Booking Chinese rail with a foreign passport, including 12306 registration.
- [China Train Seat Guide](https://eventurus.cn/train-guide.html): Second, first and business class, hard and soft sleeper, compared.
- [Metro and Subway Guide](https://eventurus.cn/metro-guide.html): Payment, city apps and operating hours on Chinese metro systems.
- [Didi and Taxi Guide](https://eventurus.cn/didi-guide.html): Didi without Chinese, car types, fares and driver phrases.
- [E-Bike Rental in China](https://eventurus.cn/ebike-rental-china.html): What a foreign visitor may legally ride: the 25 km/h line between an electric bicycle and a motorcycle, licences, plates, helmet fines and rental rates from Yangshuo to Shanghai. Verified October 2026 against published standards and provincial rules.

## Money and connectivity

- [China Tax Refund for Tourists](https://eventurus.cn/china-tax-refund.html): Departure VAT refund: 200 yuan minimum per shop per day, 11 per cent headline rate less about 2 per cent agency fee, 90 days to leave, airport steps and instant refund.
- [WeChat Pay and Alipay Guide](https://eventurus.cn/payment-guide.html): Mobile payments from download to first scan, including foreign card linking.
- [TenPayGo: WeChat Pay for Visitors](https://eventurus.cn/tenpaygo.html): WeChat Pay's standalone app for short-term visitors, from sign-up and card linking to the limits that apply.
- [Get Online in China: eSIM and SIM](https://eventurus.cn/internet-guide.html): eSIMs bought before arrival against airport SIM counters, and what works behind the firewall.
- [Essential Apps for China](https://eventurus.cn/essential-apps.html): What to install before landing: WeChat, Alipay, Didi, Meituan, Trip.com.

## Food, shopping and culture

- [Shopping on Taobao, JD and Pinduoduo](https://eventurus.cn/shopping-guide.html): China's e-commerce platforms as a foreigner, from registration to returns.
- [Markets in Shanghai](https://eventurus.cn/china-markets.html): Custom tailoring at the South Bund fabric market, Qipu Road as a wholesale district in decline, and how to shop a wet market.
- [What to Buy in China](https://eventurus.cn/china-souvenirs.html): Tea, silk, porcelain and carved seals, and the four categories customs stops: ivory, coral, pre-1949 objects, valuable herbal medicine.
- [Food Delivery: Meituan and Ele.me](https://eventurus.cn/food-delivery-guide.html): Ordering delivery as a foreigner, from app setup and address entry to rider calls.
- [Eating in China](https://eventurus.cn/dining-guide.html): QR-code ordering, dietary needs and twenty dishes with their Chinese names.
- [Chinese Menu Translator](https://eventurus.cn/menu-translator.html): 200 Chinese menu items in English, searchable and grouped by category.
- [Chinese To-Go Cards](https://eventurus.cn/chinese-cards.html): Printable Chinese-English phrase cards for taxis, restaurants, hotels and emergencies.
- [Museums and Galleries Guide](https://eventurus.cn/museums-guide.html): Collections across China with booking routes and opening hours.
- [Great Wall of China Guide](https://eventurus.cn/great-wall-guide.html): Which section to visit: Badaling, Mutianyu, Simatai and beyond.
- [What to Do in China](https://eventurus.cn/must-do.html): Fourteen experiences worth planning a trip around.
- [Where to Go in China](https://eventurus.cn/must-go.html): An edited guide to the country's most worthwhile destinations.
- [Your First Weekend in Shanghai](https://eventurus.cn/first-weekend-shanghai.html): A weekend in Shanghai that needs no planning.
- [Moving to Shanghai: Your First Week](https://eventurus.cn/moving-shanghai.html): The first week of a move to Shanghai, practically.

## Planning

- [China Travel Tools](https://eventurus.cn/): The full tool index: transit matrix, visa checker, weather guide, phrase cards.
- [Beijing in 3 Days](https://eventurus.cn/beijing-3day-itinerary.html): A first-trip route through the Palace Museum, the hutongs and one day on the Wall, with booking priorities and pacing.
- [Shanghai in 3 Days](https://eventurus.cn/shanghai-3day-itinerary.html): The old city, the Bund and the former French Concession in three days, with museum timing and alternatives.
- [Day Trips from Beijing](https://eventurus.cn/day-trips-beijing.html): The Great Wall, Summer Palace, Ming Tombs, Gubei Water Town and Tianjin, compared by pace and transport.
- [Day Trips from Shanghai](https://eventurus.cn/day-trips-shanghai.html): Suzhou, Hangzhou, Zhujiajiao and Qibao, compared by door-to-door effort and booking needs.
- [Trip Planner](https://eventurus.cn/trip-planner.html): Destinations by interest, season and trip length.
- [China City Season and Weather Guide](https://eventurus.cn/city-season.html): Best season for 35+ cities, with monthly temperature, rainfall and AQI.
- [China Public Holidays](https://eventurus.cn/china-holidays.html): Holiday calendar through 2029, with the official 2026 schedule.
- [China Packing Checklist](https://eventurus.cn/packing-checklist.html): Seasonal packing, electronics and prohibited items.
